Ship Modules

Found within the Patriotic Administration Center, Ship Modules can be upgraded to assist the Helldiver with their Missions.


Contents

  • 1 Super Destroyer Upgrade(s)
  • 2 Module Upgrades
  • 3 Notes
  • 4 Change History
  • 5 References

Super Destroyer Upgrade(s)

On release, there were three upgrade tiers per section of the Super Destroyer. Occasionally, additional upgrades may be released. It is important to note that the upgrades only affect the Helldiver that purchases them. These upgrades also change the appearance of the interior and exterior of the Super Destroyer.

On 2024-04-11, in a configuration change between patch 1.000.202 and 1.000.203, a fourth upgrade was released for all ship sections.[1][2]

On 2024-07-05, in patch 1.000.404, a fifth upgrade was released for all ship sections.[3][4]

Module Upgrades

Ship Modules cost Common Sample, Rare Sample, and Super Sample to upgrade. Requisition Slips are also required beginning at tier 4.

Notes

  • There are two achievements associated with Ship Modules: 'Ship it!' awarded for upgrading all ship modules at least 1 level, and 'Fully operational' awarded for reaching max level on one ship module.
    • 'Fully operational' was easier at launch as there were only three tiers of modules available at the time. When the additional tiers were added, the achievement was not retroactively adjusted.
